title: Super Super Glue
description: A texture pack for Create that retextures Super Glue into Super Super Glue from Matilda (1996)
body:
Changes the Super Glue from Create into Super Super Glue from Matilda (1996). 

Features:
- Changes the texture of the super glue into an image of Super Super Glue from Matilda (1996).
- Changes all mentions of Super Glue into Super Super Glue

Only changes text in English.

Tested on Create 1.20.1
